seo.title: Compare – HubGet
seo.description: Looking for a way to install apps on Windows? See how HubGet differs from other tools – including where they do better.
seo.ogDescription: Looking for a way to install apps on Windows? See how HubGet differs from other tools – including where they do better.

texty.t2: How HubGet stacks up against the alternatives.
texty.t3: Looking for a way to install apps on Windows? See how HubGet differs from other tools – including where they do better.
texty.t5: Ninite made installing several apps at once popular. But it offers around 150 hand-picked apps and can’t uninstall them without the paid version. HubGet has more than 25,000 apps in its catalog and manages them from install to uninstall.
texty.t7: Updates and uninstalls right in the app
texty.t8: Free and open source, for businesses too
texty.t11: UniGetUI is a mature desktop app for managing packages from many package managers at once. HubGet takes a different path: instead of a package list, it’s an app store where you discover, compare and install apps like in the App Store.
texty.t12: A Today home page, collections and charts
texty.t13: One app = one card with every source
texty.t14: Regular user mode without libraries and tools
texty.t17: Winstall.app is a website where you pick apps from WinGet and get a command to run in your terminal. HubGet installs, updates and uninstalls apps from WinGet, Chocolatey and Scoop for you.
texty.t18: Install, update and uninstall right in the app
texty.t20: A fallback source when a WinGet download link is broken
